description: GWAS study type classification and quality tiers for BlueGen

type_descriptions.meta_analysis: Large multi-cohort meta-analysis (n > 50K, p < 5×10⁻⁸). Highest evidence quality.
type_descriptions.multi_population: Multi-ancestry study covering 2+ continental populations. Good cross-population portability.
type_descriptions.discovery: Well-powered single-ancestry GWAS with independent replication.
type_descriptions.replicated: Candidate gene replicated across multiple independent studies.
type_descriptions.single_study: Single study with suggestive association (p < 10⁻³). Requires replication.
type_descriptions.candidate_gene: Hypothesis-driven candidate gene study. Limited genome-wide coverage.
type_descriptions.mendelian: Mendelian trait with known causal variant(s). Non-GWAS evidence.
type_descriptions.mechanistic: Mechanistic or functional annotation-based. No formal GWAS evidence.
type_descriptions.proxy: Proxy or indirect evidence from related traits or populations.
